snippet.title: Giri-Jump Star Rush - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Giri Jump Star Rush is a classic-style 2D action game refined for a modern feel. Our top priority is "tactile satisfaction." The character moves exactly as you imagine, following your intended path with precision. Experience a light, responsive playfeel designed to be "fun just to move."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207890/GiriJump_Star_Rush/
